tank.name: XDB
tank.appearanceSvg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="512" height="512" viewBox="0 0 512 512">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="metalGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#444;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#111;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="redArmor" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#B22222;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#8B0000;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="neonGlow">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2" result="blur" />
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur" />
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Left Track -->
  <rect x="96" y="100" width="80" height="312" rx="10" fill="#222" stroke="#444" stroke-width="4" />
  <rect x="110" y="120" width="52" height="272" fill="#111" />
  <rect x="115" y="140" width="42" height="20" fill="#333" />
  <rect x="115" y="180" width="42" height="20" fill="#333" />
  <rect x="115" y="220" width="42" height="20" fill="#333" />
  <rect x="115" y="260" width="42" height="20" fill="#333" />
  <rect x="115" y="300" width="42" height="20" fill="#333" />
  <rect x="115" y="340" width="42" height="20" fill="#333" />

  <!-- Right Track -->
  <rect x="336" y="100" width="80" height="312" rx="10" fill="#222" stroke="#444" stroke-width="4" />
  <rect x="350" y="120" width="52" height="272" fill="#111" />
  <rect x="355" y="140" width="42" height="20" fill="#333" />
  <rect x="355" y="180" width="42" height="20" fill="#333" />
  <rect x="355" y="220" width="42" height="20" fill="#333" />
  <rect x="355" y="260" width="42" height="20" fill="#333" />
  <rect x="355" y="300" width="42" height="20" fill="#333" />
  <rect x="355" y="340" width="42" height="20" fill="#333" />

  <!-- Exhaust Pipes (Steampunk Style) -->
  <rect x="190" y="380" width="20" height="60" rx="5" fill="#555" />
  <rect x="230" y="380" width="20" height="60" rx="5" fill="#555" />
  <rect x="270" y="380" width="20" height="60" rx="5" fill="#555" />
  <circle cx="200" cy="380" r="10" fill="#333" />
  <circle cx="240" cy="380" r="10" fill="#333" />
  <circle cx="280" cy="380" r="10" fill="#333" />

  <!-- Body -->
  <rect x="176" y="130" width="160" height="252" rx="15" fill="url(#metalGrad)" stroke="#000" stroke-width="4" />
  <rect x="190" y="150" width="132" height="212" rx="5" fill="url(#redArmor)" />

  <!-- Neon "Chongqing" Characters (Stylized Neon Strokes) -->
  <g filter="url(#neonGlow)" stroke="#00F2FF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
    <!-- 重 -->
    <path d="M195 200 h40 M215 200 v50 M200 220 h30 M200 235 h30 M200 250 h30" />
    <!-- 庆 -->
    <path d="M280 200 v40 M280 220 h30 M270 260 h50 M295 250 v30" />
  </g>

  <!-- Turret -->
  <circle cx="256" cy="246" r="60" fill="#222" stroke="#00F2FF" stroke-width="8" />
  
  <!-- Cannon -->
  <rect x="246" y="100" width="20" height="150" rx="4" fill="#444" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" />
  <!-- Rune on Cannon -->
  <path d="M256 160 l-6 6 l6 6 l6 -6 z" fill="#FF4500" />
  
  <!-- Turret Detail -->
  <circle cx="256" cy="246" r="20" fill="#111" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4" />
</svg>
